objects== *[[Chest]]s **[[Darkstone Chest]] *[[Volcanic Rocks]] ==Notes== *You can get the [[Volcanic Rock]] for the [[Black Moa Chick]] from the northeast part of this area. *Watch out for [[Mahgo Hydra]]s with their [[Meteor Shower]]. They can also do massive damage through other fire skills. *Martial Professions will want to bring a way to deal with [[Blind]] as [[Phantom (NPC)|Phantom]]s [[Popup|pop up]] throughout the zone. *Caster Professions will also want to bring a way to deal with [[Interrupts]] as [[Phantom (NPC)|Phantom]]s carry 3 with one of them being [[Cry of Frustration]] which is an [[area of effect]] interrupt. ====Titles==== *Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.2% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title track. *{{Vanquisher|count = 230|low = 215|high = 252}} **There are less foes after accepting the quest reward for [[Final Blow]]. **Having [[Proof of Triumph]] in the inventory will make a further group with [[Abaddon's Cursed]] spawn. *Not all of the [[elite skill]]s are available for capture in any one instance of the map. ====Bosses==== *Not all bosses listed above will [[spawn]] in the same map [[instance]]. Generally, only one boss will spawn at each spawn point. **Any spawn point may spawn more than one boss. **Occasionally no boss spawns at a spawn point for Abomination or Ghost bosses. **Sometimes, not all of the Phantom bosses will spawn. **Harn and Maxine Coldstone will not spawn in the same instance. **Since there are four spawn points shared by the Ettin boss and two Hydra bosses, one of the spawn points will be empty. **An easy way to capture the elite skills of the [[Ghost]] and [[Abomination]] bosses is to exit from [[Ember Light Camp]] and then run to the first boss location to the east (one or two bosses will spawn there). If the boss you are looking for is not there then re[[zone]]. This could take many tries since there are 5 Abominations and 3 Phantom bosses and their spawn is random. ==Trivia== *[[w:Perdition|Perdition]] is Hell in the Christian religion, which houses Satan and other demons. This is probably referring to the [[Ring of Fire Island Chain]]'s volcanic landscape, as well as the [[Undead]] that can be found there. *This area has the most elite skills available for capture in [[Guild Wars]]. {{Explorable areas in the Ring of Fire Islands}} [[de:Fels der Verdammnis]]
